verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Custom workflows and reporting", and the FAQ mentions consolidated reporting, which is a thin, generic claim of custom reports. Nothing shows a self-service report builder or filtering and grouping by class, location, or tag, and the reporting appears to be delivered by Pilot's service team. Missing for 10: evidence of class/location/tag dimension filtering and grouping, a self-service custom report builder for accountants, detailed docs or hands-on corroboration.
